description: Named the left side, and put the rest under the cloth.
name: Alse Pinder

description: Measured the thumb, and refused a house fed on hints.
name: Mistress Dorcas Ansell

description: Not the dinner. Left where he was.
name: Gib

description: Answered short and cold from his pew, and did not look across.
name: Sir John Spencer

description: Gave the litany, and a sermon that did not stay.
name: Master Josias Thwaite

description: A dark head under a plain hood in the north aisle. It did not turn, and it did not speak.
name: the lady of the parish

description: Set the cross, and left the rest of the table empty.
name: William Shakespeare
